items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: Played drums. And we just played and played and played.

ctx.x: So I was this thing and . . . musician. And they got Bix to sit in. And Bix called some tune for some reason . . . . Whatever it was, Win, just got up again and walked over to me and grabbed me like everything's forgotten, sat me up there to play with them. And I will never forget it, because I played with him until the porter swept us out.
